verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI generation of job descriptions, outreach copy, or rejection notes in the recruiter's tone. The AI features documented are interview notetaking and summaries, Voice AI screening interviews, Talent Matching tiering, Offer Forecast, and AI report filters. Bulk outreach campaigns are described as "automated, personalized and optimized," but nothing says AI writes the message text. Rejection appears only as an API workflow action, not as generated wording.
